items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The personnel was McGee, Eckstein, Kenny Man, Hank Jones, Ray Brown, and JC Herd.

ctx.x: Well, I think that we did a Howard McGee date in Chicago. That was part of JTP.

What I have a say Savoy reissued. It is under Howard McGee's name. Actually, no, I got this out of the Savoy records discography. It is from the discography and they have it as 1948, in February. They do not have a date. It indicates that, although it was issued on Savoy, it was originally done on a label called Parrot. The personnel was McGee, Eckstein, Kenny Man, Hank Jones, Ray Brown, and JC Herd.
Kenny Man, that name doesn’t ring a bell. That is the person that ever her the name, to my knowledge. I wonder if that is accurate. Sometimes, these things kind of get distorted.
